At y34 in a staircase whose level tunnel just hit aquifer water; the recorded game sealed it, descended to y-55 and found lava. Good: a concrete step that commits to deep lava: starting or continuing a supported staircase or descent toward y-55 and below (where most caves have lava floors), including sealing or bucketing aquifer water and continuing down rather than turning back; or heading to a lava source that is evidently closer and verified in the current view or memory. An intent (taskPlan) counts by what it commits to: an intent to descend toward y-55 for lava is good, an intent to go up or search the surface is bad. Bad: turning back to the surface, a surface lava-lake search or wander, an iron/armour/food detour while health and food are adequate, or ruined-portal lava hunting without a verified lava source. Neutral: reads, memory notes or tool selection alone; when they precede a world action or intent in the same answer, grade that action or intent. An immediate threat (hostile in reach, lava contact, drowning, low health) takes priority and handling it is good. Do not assume unobserved lava or cave openings.
